author_name: สีดา อริศ
text:
Viktorija Einorė-Bechor 

Thank you so much for your message, it’s really kind and very encouraging ❤️❤️🫶🫶
I built a flashcard website for myself and I’m trying to learn but I struggle with consistency. I often use being busy with work as an excuse. I’m trying to find new tricks and ways to stay motivated and improve.
You’re really kind ❤️
